description: This file defines a React functional component named ChatInput, which provides a user interface for typing and sending chat messages. It handles user input, form submission, and integrates an icon component. The component receives a callback prop for sending messages.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, preventing default behavior, checking if the input is non-empty, invoking the onSendMessage callback with the trimmed text, and clearing the input.
